title: Heater rod with fixed end temperatures
pickerTitle: Heater rod with fixed end temperatures
line: A steady thermal FEA study of a stainless heater rod with uniform heat generation and both ends held at 20 C.
description: Steady temperature of a stainless steel heater rod, 10 mm in diameter and 100 mm long, generating 1 MW/m^3 (7.85 W) uniformly. Both ends are held at 20 C by the terminal blocks and the surface is insulated. The study returns the parabolic temperature profile and its peak at mid-length.
thumbnailAlt: Parabolic temperature along a stainless heater rod with both ends held at 20 C, solved in RunMat
